'''Toka''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] who held the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]]. In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], Admiral Toka was in [[Tak Base]] when it was [[Attack on Tak Base|attacked]] by [[Dark Trooper/Legends|dark troopers]] and was subsequently [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the assault.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I'll send a distress signal, but I fear all is lost. ''Go''! And may the Force be with you!|Admiral Toka, to Captain Bok|<ref name="Sand Blasted" />}}
[[File:TokaDies-SandBlasted.png|thumb|left|180px|Admiral Toka is killed during the attack on Tak Base.]]
Toka was an [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] in the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Rebel Alliance Fleet]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Sand Blasted" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="Year" /> Toka was stationed at [[Tak Base]], a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] installation on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Talay/Legends|Talay]], when Imperial [[General/Legends|General]] [[Rom Mohc]] tested [[Gender/Legends|his]] new [[Dark Trooper Project]] by launching [[Dark Trooper/Legends|dark troopers]] in a devastating assault against the base.<ref name="Sand Blasted" />

As the Imperial attack rained down, Toka ordered Rebel [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Bok (Mon Calamari)|Bok]] to flee Talay aboard the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] ''[[Grey Damsel]]'' using escape coordinates provided to them by the Alliance. Soon thereafter, Toka sent out a [[Distress signal/Legends|distress signal]] to anyone who might receive it but was immediately [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Blaster/Legends|blasterfire]].<ref name="Sand Blasted" /> Five [[Standard day/Legends|days]] after Toka's death, Alliance [[Chief of State (Alliance)/Legends|leader]] [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] showed the admiral's distress signal to [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Kyle Katarn]] in preparation for his follow-up investigatory [[mission to Talay]].<ref name="Dark Forces" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Escape while you still ''can'', my friend! Warn our allies of this ''new'' threat!''"<br />"''But we can't ''abandon'' you here, Admiral Toka!''"<br />"''Launch now or perish! Use the escape coordinates the Alliance gave us. ''Flee''!|Admiral Toka and Captain Bok|<ref name="Sand Blasted" />}}
During the Imperial massacre of the Rebellion's Tak Base, Admiral Toka demonstrated his selflessness by ordering his friend and fellow [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] Captain Bok to escape Talay and warn the Alliance of the Empire's new threat rather than risk trying to rescue Toka. The admiral volunteered to stay behind and transmit a distress signal, even though doing so meant abandoning himself to his fate. As a Mon Calamari, Toka had [[Color/Legends|orange]] skin and yellow [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="Sand Blasted" />

==Equipment==
Admiral Toka wore the [[Mon Cal uniform jerkin]]<ref name="Sand Blasted" /><ref name="Complete Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> during his service at Tak Base.<ref name="Sand Blasted" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Toka-DarkForces.png|thumb|right|250px|''Star Wars: Dark Forces'' used ''Return of the Jedi'' film footage of Admiral Ackbar to depict Toka in holographic form.]]
Admiral Toka first appeared in the [[1995]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Dark Forces]]'', in which he was voiced by [[Denny Delk]] and identified in the credits only as "Dying Rebel." ''Dark Forces'' used footage of Admiral [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]] from the film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']] to depict Toka's [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] form.<ref name="Dark Forces" />

Toka was later identified by name in the [[2000]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic story]] "[[Sand Blasted]]," written by [[Kilian Plunkett]] and published in [[Star Wars Tales 4|''Star Wars Tales'' 4]], which expanded upon the Talay massacre from ''Dark Forces''.<ref name="Sand Blasted" />
